metricDefinitions.name: Research Activity
metricDefinitions.description: Count of distinct sampled papers fully attributed to the entity, followed by active-cohort within-year scaling.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: Relative publication participation in this technical sample, not research quality or complete output.

metricDefinitions.name: Research Impact
metricDefinitions.description: log1p of the summed non-self-citation count across fully attributed sampled papers, followed by active-cohort within-year scaling.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: Relative citation metadata in this sample; it is age-dependent and not a quality evaluation.

metricDefinitions.name: Collaboration / Connectivity
metricDefinitions.description: Count of distinct co-participating institutions or countries in sampled papers, followed by active-cohort within-year scaling.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: Relative connectivity visible in the bounded sample, not a measure of collaboration quality.

metricDefinitions.name: Research Diversity
metricDefinitions.description: Reserved taxonomy definition for future pilot expansion.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: No diversity value is calculated from the bounded pilot sample.
requiredData: future validated topic and subfield representation

metricDefinitions.name: Research Momentum / Sustainability
metricDefinitions.description: Participation difference between t-2..t and t-5..t-3 divided by the combined-window participation (with a denominator floor of one), followed by active-cohort within-year scaling.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: Relative change inside the bounded sample; it is neither a forecast nor evidence of sustainability.

metricDefinitions.name: Talent Ecosystem
metricDefinitions.description: Reserved taxonomy definition for future pilot expansion.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: No researcher-development or mobility value is calculated in this release.

metricDefinitions.name: Concentration / Vulnerability
metricDefinitions.description: Reserved taxonomy definition for future pilot expansion.
metricDefinitions.interpretation: No concentration or vulnerability value is calculated in this release.
requiredData: future validated dependency and concentration data
